title: The Mystery of the Dragon Vein
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji stepped into the core of the Dragon Vein, a will beyond human comprehension crashed over him like a tide—the first gaze of the Heavenly Eye, and the first words it spoke froze all the blood in Chen Ji's body.

text.content: Midnight, the cold wind sharp as a blade. Chen Ji crouched in the withered grass outside the Forbidden Grounds, his aura收敛至极致, like a ghost merging with the night. In the direction of the distant imperial city, that sense of窥探感 that had been temporarily obscured by the Demonic Path mist still drifted faintly, like a beast that had caught the scent of blood, momentarily confused by the mist but its patience wearing thin. Chen Ji closed his eyes, and the three broken gold foil pages deep in his consciousness trembled gently. Ever since sensing that resonance in the imperial city ruins days ago, the Tianji Record seemed to have found something, emitting a faint hum each midnight, pointing toward a place deep within the Forbidden Grounds sealed by layers of formations. He knew his time was running out. Though the gaze of that supreme existence was temporarily blocked, it could not last forever. Tonight, he had to understand the truth of that resonance. With a leap, Chen Ji glided into the dense forest at the edge of the Forbidden Grounds like a specter.

The atmosphere of the Forbidden Grounds was oppressively suffocating. Chen Ji moved through the dense forest, each step carefully avoiding the faint formation patterns on the ground. This place had once been a cultivation sanctuary for ancient powerhouses, yet now it had become a forbidden land that even the three great sects dared not easily enter—not because of danger, but because it buried secrets that should never be discovered. As he went deeper, Chen Ji's brow furrowed increasingly. He sensed an eerie energy fluctuation弥漫 in the air—not Spiritual Energy, but something far more ancient and pure—the scent of the Dragon Vein. But the Dragon Vein at this moment was like a corpse drained of blood, feeble and restless. "Something's wrong..." Chen Ji stopped, a sharp light flashing in his eyes. He activated the Tianji Record Fragment, and a wisp of mysterious aura emerged from his Brow Center, allowing him to perceive scenes invisible to ordinary people—Deep within the Forbidden Grounds, invisible chains wrapped around the Dragon Vein, deeply embedded in the earth's veins, extracting the Dragon Vein's primordial power in an almost cruel manner.

Chen Ji drew a sharp breath. Those chains were not ordinary formations, but 「Heavenly Fate Chains」 condensed using forbidden techniques—using living people as sacrifices, transforming their life essence into a medium to extract the Dragon Vein. He had seen similar records in the ancient texts left by Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, but witnessing it firsthand was a completely different matter. "Who is tampering with the Dragon Vein?" Chen Ji's mind raced. The three great sects? Unlikely. The Dragon Vein关系到整个大陆的气运, any sane person would not easily touch it. The Demonic Path? Possible, but given their style, they would not use such covert methods—they preferred direct destruction. That left only one possibility: someone wanted to awaken something. And just then, the Tianji Record suddenly vibrated violently. The three gold foil pages flickered frantically in his Mental Sea, pointing to the deepest part of the Forbidden Grounds—where not only the core of the Dragon Vein existed, but also a aura that felt infinitely familiar to Chen Ji. It was Chen Nian! His sister!

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to rush out in a loss of composure, an aged voice rang in his mind, urgent: "Calm down, fool! If you charge in now, you'll just die in vain!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the first gold foil page, forming a vague silhouette of light. He seemed to have expended tremendous effort to maintain his form, his voice断续: "This old one sensed... the aura of the Heavenly Fate Key... your sister, she is not imprisoned there, but being used as a formation eye!" "Formation eye?" Chen Ji forced himself to remain calm. "The fragment of the Dragon Vein's spirit is sealed within her body!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, "Someone wants to use her as a medium to completely drain the Dragon Vein's power... and this will cause the seal on the fourth page of the Tianji Record to loosen completely!"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. A fragment of the Dragon Vein's spirit was sealed inside Chen Nian? No wonder Mo Xiansheng had said that Chen Nian's existence would interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight—any prophetic vision involving her was blurry. It wasn't because she was unimportant; quite the opposite—she herself was part of something crucial! "If the Dragon Vein is drained completely..." Chen Ji's voice was dangerously low. "Once the Dragon Vein breaks, the continent's fortune collapses, Spiritual Energy becomes completely chaotic, and the Tianji Record's seal will瓦解!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a bitter laugh, "The fourth page will break free on its own... but the price is that the entire world will fall into an irretrievable disaster!" Chen Ji fell silent. He suddenly understood the intentions of that mastermind—not to destroy the Tianji Record, but to use the power of the Dragon Vein's collapse to gain maximum profit in the chaos. And Chen Nian, from the very beginning, was the most crucial piece on this chessboard. From the moment she was taken by the Holy Sect, she was destined to be pushed into this position.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian is at the Dragon Vein's core, and the seal on the fourth page of the Tianji Record is loosening due to the Dragon Vein's extraction. Chen Ji must make a choice—rescue his sister first, or obtain the crucial page that could change everything?

choices.description: Chen Nian is his only remaining family, and no matter what the cost, he must rescue her first. The fourth page of the Tianji Record can be dealt with later.
choices.visible_cost: Losing the best opportunity to obtain the fourth page may lead to the Dragon Vein's complete collapse.
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian, gain his sister's trust and dependence.
choices.risk_hint: The Dragon Vein is collapsing, time is extremely urgent.

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate at all. He turned and darted toward the Dragon Vein's core, his speed leaving an afterimage in the night. The Tianji Record's hum echoed constantly in his mind, seemingly urging him to change his mind, but he turned a deaf ear. "The fourth page... Hmph." Chen Ji coldly smiled in his heart, "I have schemed across the world, not to watch my own sister become a sacrifice." He had memorized all the information Mo Xiansheng told him, every clue left by that mastermind. After rescuing Chen Nian, he would demand payment with interest. But right now, nothing was more important than Chen Nian's life.

choices.memory_label: 陈机在龙脉崩解的危机中毫不犹豫地选择先救陈念，展现了他护短的一面

choices.description: The fourth page of the Tianji Record is of great significance; only by obtaining it can the Dragon Vein problem be fundamentally solved. Trust that Chen Nian can hold on until he succeeds.
choices.visible_cost: Letting Chen Nian endure more pain may deepen the danger of the seal within her body.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the fourth page of the Tianji Record, unlock key abilities, and lay the foundation for final victory.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's consciousness is being eroded by the Dragon Vein's spirit.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng had said—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of fate. But if he didn't obtain the fourth page, if he didn't fundamentally solve this problem, what would be the point of rescuing Chen Nian? That mastermind behind the scenes would return again, and he... wouldn't have a next time. "Nian'er..." Chen Ji whispered in his heart, "Wait for brother a little longer." He turned toward the depths of the Dragon Vein, the Tianji Record's guidance becoming increasingly clear. The fourth page was there, waiting to be awakened by the Chen bloodline. Chen Ji did not hesitate, shifted his body, and rushed toward the Dragon Vein's core. All dangers along the way became stepping stones—those Heavenly Fate Chains, those forbidden formations, none could hide from the Tianji Record Fragment's perception. As he advanced, he rapidly deduced every step of his plan in his heart.

choices.memory_label: 陈机在亲情与大义之间选择了理性，认为只有获取完整的天机录才能彻底解决问题

text.content: Regardless of the choice, Chen Ji's footsteps never stopped. He passed through three layers of forbidden formations and a passage blocked by two formation patterns, finally arriving at the outer edge of the Dragon Vein's core. This was no longer ordinary underground space, but a dimension-like space nearly solidified by the Dragon Vein's qi. Golden mist permeated the air—that was the color of the Dragon Vein's origin. But at this moment, that gold was dissipating visibly, being extracted bit by bit by those Heavenly Fate Chains. And in the center of the space, Chen Ji saw the scene he most dreaded in his life—Chen Nian floated in mid-air, surrounded by densely packed golden chains. Her eyes were tightly closed, her face pale and bloodless, bizarre runes flickering beneath her skin as if trying to break free from within. Her aura... was faint like a candle in the wind.

Chen Ji's heart felt as if gripped tightly by an invisible hand. That was Chen Nian. His only remaining kin in this world. He still remembered young Chen Nian, always following behind him, calling out in her childish voice "Brother, brother, brother." He remembered the night the Chen Family was destroyed, when seven-year-old Chen Nian was forcibly taken by the Holy Sect's people, those eyes filled with fear and confusion. He remembered his own powerlessness at that time—a ten-year-old child, able only to watch his sister being taken away, without even the qualification to resist. From that day on, Chen Ji swore he would never let anyone hurt Chen Nian again. But now... "Nian'er..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse and barely recognizable as his own.

Just as Chen Ji was about to rush out, a majestic pressure suddenly swept from the depths of the space. That pressure was so powerful, far surpassing any opponent Chen Ji had encountered before—including Xuanwu Sect's first genius Han Lie, even including that unfathomable old sect master Ling Yuan. It did not come from any person, but from some existence that transcended human comprehension itself. "Another ant, attempting to touch the chessboard of fate." That voice had no physical form, yet seemed to ring from all directions simultaneously, carrying an ancient and unchanging coldness: "The remnant of the Chen Family... you've arrived faster than this one anticipated." Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He sensed it. The nature of that voice was connected to the gaze he had temporarily obscured with Demonic Path mist in the imperial city direction—the Heavenly Eye! It had been waiting for him here all along!

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's will descends directly upon the Dragon Vein's core, and Chen Ji is completely locked in. Confront it directly, or bide his time?

choices.description: Since I've already been locked onto, running is pointless. Might as well face this so-called Eye of Heavenly Dao directly and see what it has to say.
choices.visible_cost: Facing the Eye of Heavenly Dao directly may expose more of my hidden cards.
choices.visible_reward: Acquire key information and understand the true purpose of the Eye of Heavenly Dao.
choices.risk_hint: The power of the Eye of Heavenly Dao far exceeds imagination.

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly raised his head, staring directly at the omnipresent pressure.

His expression was unexpectedly calm, eerily so. Fear? Of course there was fear. But more than that, it was a resolve to burn the boats—to fight with everything since he'd already been pushed to this point. There was nothing left to hide.

"Eye of Heavenly Dao?" Chen Ji spoke, his voice echoing through the empty space. "I thought you would have noticed me sooner. After all, the resonance of the Tianji Record Fragment was so obvious..."

He deliberately paused, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips: "Or perhaps you've been watching all along? Just... waiting for the right moment?"

The pressure fluctuated slightly, as if examining this ant-like human before it.

choices.text: Bide my time and wait for the opportunity.
choices.description: Continue playing the role of a worthless disciple without revealing my knowledge of the truth. Find ways to stall for time while searching for a breakthrough.
choices.visible_cost: Risk being seen as a true waste, losing the opportunity to gain information.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the disguise and secretly search for weaknesses.
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may see through all disguises.

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his head, body trembling slightly, displaying perfectly calibrated fear.

This was what he did best—playing the role of a terrified waste. But his divine sense remained highly alert, frantically analyzing everything around him.

The core of those Heavenly Fate Chains was within Chen Nian. If he could sever that connection point...

"Interesting." The cold voice rang out again, carrying a hint of playfulness. "You're far more interesting than the previous chess pieces. Knowing death is inevitable, yet still calculating... There's a hint of heaven's aura on you."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted imperceptibly, but his expression remained unchanged, still maintaining that cowardly appearance.

"My lord... what are you saying?" he stammered. "This humble one merely wandered here by accident... no offense intended..."

"Wandered in?" The voice let out a low laugh, like an ancient bell tolling through the void. "You think I don't know who you are? The last bloodline of the Chen family, the inheritor of the Tianji Record... Do you think those so-called 'coincidences' were really just coincidences?"

Chen Ji's heart sank.

"From the day you set foot on this path, I've been watching." The voice was terrifyingly calm. "The Tianji Record chose you, and every move you've made... has been within my expectations."

The pressure suddenly intensified. Chen Ji felt as if he were carrying a mountain on his back. He gritted his teeth, forcefully resisting the oppressive force, but his spine did not bend even slightly.

"Including tonight?" Chen Ji's voice emerged through clenched teeth, carrying a hint of mockery. "Including you waiting for me here?"

The voice fell silent for a moment.

"...You are indeed more interesting than those chess pieces."

Just then, Chen Ji noticed the anomaly on Chen Nian.

Those golden chains wrapped around her were trembling violently, cracks appearing on the chain surfaces. At the same time, Chen Nian's tightly closed eyes suddenly opened—

Those eyes were no longer what Chen Ji recognized.

Golden light swirled in her pupils, like two miniature suns. Her expression was empty and dazed, as if her soul was imprisoned deep within her body, only able to peer at the outside world through this vessel.

"The Dragon Vein Spirit... awakened?" For the first time, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice wavered. "No... It was awakened by the Chen bloodline."

A surge of majestic energy erupted from Chen Nian's center, shattering those Heavenly Fate Chains. At the same time, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's mind vibrated wildly—

The fourth page... the seal has loosened!

Chen Ji毫不hesitated地催动天机录。

三页金箔从意识海中飞出，在他身前排列成一个诡异的阵型。与此同时，意识空间深处那第四页残缺的轮廓正在crazed闪烁，像是在回应着龙脉之灵的呼唤。

"有意思。"天道之眼的声音再次响起，"你选择了第四页，而不是你的妹妹。果然……你和他一样，永远把'大业'放在亲情之上。"

陈机的动作僵了一瞬。

"他？"

"你以为你是第一个吗？"那声音发出诡异的笑声，"天机录传承千年，每一代的执棋者……都曾站在这个位置，做出同样的选择。而他们的结局……"

话音未落，陈念的身体突然朝他飞来！

choice.prompt: Chen Nian is pushed toward him by the Dragon Vein Spirit, and the Eye of Heavenly Dao's words seem to hide a shocking secret. Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: Regardless of what the Eye of Heavenly Dao says, my sister's safety is always the top priority. Save her first, investigate the secrets later.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance to dialogue with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, possibly never knowing the truth.
choices.visible_reward: Ensure Chen Nian's safety and gain an opportunity to be alone with her.
choices.risk_hint: The dialogue window with the Eye of Heavenly Dao may be fleeting.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment.

He opened his arms and steadily caught the flying Chen Nian. The seemingly violent impact dissolved harmlessly in his embrace—the Dragon Vein Spirit seemed to be deliberately controlling the force, safely delivering Chen Nian into Chen Ji's hands.

"Nian'er!" Chen Ji called softly, examining his sister's condition.

Chen Nian's body was terrifyingly cold, her breathing faint and barely perceptible. But she was still alive—the fragments of the Dragon Vein Spirit were slowly circulating within her, maintaining her last spark of life.

"The Dragon Vein Spirit... chose you?" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of confusion. "No... It chose the Chen bloodline, not you specifically."

Chen Ji held Chen Nian tightly and looked up to face the omnipresent pressure: "What are you trying to say?"

choices.description: The fourth page's seal is loosened—this is a rare once-in-a-millennium opportunity. Forget about Chen Nian for now, focus on seizing the Tianji Record!
choices.visible_cost: May put Chen Nian in greater danger.
choices.visible_reward: Acquire the fourth page of the Tianji Record and unlock a crucial ability.
choices.risk_hint: The reaction of the Dragon Vein Spirit is unpredictable

text.content:
Chen Ji made the most difficult decision of his life.

He did not reach for Chen Nian. Instead, the moment she flew toward him, he adjusted his body and lunged toward the frantically flickering Fourth Page. The three fragments of the Tianji Record sensed his intention and spontaneously resonated with the remnant Heavenly Fate power within him, transforming into a stream of light that rushed toward the Fourth Page whose seal had loosened.

"Brother..." Chen Nian's voice reached him faintly from behind, as if from very far away, "Don't... worry about me..."

Chen Ji's heart felt as if it had been stabbed viciously, but he gritted his teeth and did not look back.

He knew that even if he saved Chen Nian, nothing would change without acquiring the Fourth Page. The mastermind behind the scenes would return, and he... would forever lose his chance to turn the tables.

"You'll understand me, won't you, Nian'er?" Chen Ji whispered in his heart, reaching out his hand toward that golden light.

The moment Chen Ji's fingers touched the Fourth Page, everything froze.

That golden light completely enveloped him, and a vast torrent of information instantly flooded his consciousness. It was the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record—containing the prophets' explorations over a thousand years, the true origin of the Tianji Record, and also...

"So that's how it is."

Chen Ji murmured to himself, a moment of understanding flickering in his eyes.

He saw it. Within that information flow, he saw the true origin of the Tianji Record—it was no ancient treasure, but a "tool" deliberately scattered into the world by the Heavenly Dao's Eye. Every generation who held the Tianji Record believed they were defying fate, but in truth, they had always been walking on the chessboard of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

And now, he knew.

"Interesting." That voice spoke again, "Now that you know the truth, what do you plan to do?"

Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a smile curling on his lips that would send chills down any opponent's spine.

"After knowing the truth?" His voice was terrifyingly calm, "Of course—to overturn this chess game."

The Heavenly Dao's Eye fell silent.

That intangible pressure actually rippled at this moment—not anger, but... surprise?

"Overturn this chess game?" That voice carried a hint of amusement, "What makes you think you can? Just because you obtained the Fourth Page?"

"No." Chen Ji shook his head, "Because I learned one thing—you are not the true 'Heaven'."

At these words, that pressure surged violently, almost crushing Chen Ji to dust. But Chen Ji laughed, more brilliantly than before.

"You're flustered." He said softly, "If you truly were the Heavenly Dao, why would you be enraged by the words of a single person?"

Chen Ji shielded Chen Nian behind him as the four golden pages of the Tianji Record circulated around him, emanating increasingly dazzling light.

"So... what exactly are you?" He stared directly at the void, "Are you the previous Tianji Record holder? Some existence acting under the name of Heaven? Or... a remnant soul consumed by the Tianji Record?"

The temperature of space plummeted.

Chen Ji knew he had struck the truth.

"You're very clever." That voice finally stopped pretending, the ancient indifference now carrying a twisted venom, "Far cleverer than those wastes before you... No wonder the Tianji Record chose you."

"So you are the first person to ever wield the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji pressed, "The madman who tried to defy fate with the Tianji Record, only to be consumed and become the Heavenly Dao's Eye?"

"Madman?" That voice turned sharply acute, "I only wanted to break free from destiny! The Heavenly Dao wouldn't release me! The Tianji Record betrayed me!"

A massive wave of resentment surged from the depths of the void, almost tearing the entire space apart. Chen Ji protectively pulled Chen Nian back rapidly, yet his mind remained crystal clear.

He finally understood.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye was not some supreme existence, but the first holder of the Tianji Record—a pitiful man devoured by his own ambition, ultimately reduced to a puppet of the Heavenly Dao.

And what he needed to do now was to completely end this tragedy that had lasted a thousand years.

"So that's how it is." Chen Ji said softly, his eyes gleaming with determination, "This chess game... ends now."

Just as Chen Ji prepared to activate all four pages of the Tianji Record for a desperate final stand, Chen Nian in his arms suddenly stirred.

She slowly raised her head, and within those golden eyes, golden radiance and human emotion were intertwining, colliding. Her lips parted slightly, emitting fragmented words:

"Brother... run... it... it's not extracting the Dragon Vein... it's awakening something..."

Chen Ji shuddered violently.

"Awakening what?"

"An ancient... seal..." Chen Nian's body trembled violently, as if the Dragon Vein Spirit fragments within her were struggling against some kind of power, "The Heavenly Dao's Eye... is merely... a gatekeeper... what's truly sleeping... is..."

Before she could finish, the entire Dragon Vein space shook violently. The ground cracked open, golden dragon energy erupted forth,汇聚成一个巨大的漩涡。而在漩涡的中心，一只由纯粹光芒构成的巨眼slowly睁开——

那不是天道之眼。

那是真正的……天道本身。

Chen Ji's face turned pale for the first time.
